quote: the sign's chapter bounds (Isaiah 7:16; 8:3-4; 8:8) are real, but C5's own narrowing concedes Matthew 1:23's application stands, and the almah/bethulah word-count cuts both ways (Joel 1:8)
why: The judge text weighs the pressed Isaiah 7:14 witnesses verse by verse (7:16, 8:3-4, 8:8, Matthew 1:23, Joel 1:8) with no chain-against-chain weighing by footing, which rule K-C requires where the pressed witnesses are the pressing side's own chain.
